text_block_list.text:
Comrades who ran alongside Oguri Cap for 
three years. Today, we decided to hold a 
small party for them and Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
—Well, now that the Senior Arima Kinen is 
over, it feels like a good milestone, 
wouldn't ya say?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Still, Oguri really is something else! 
Taking on all of us at once and bagging a 
clean victory!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
“Still... strangely enough, I have no 
regrets. Giving it my all and running with 
Oguri-chan has become such a precious 
memory to me.”

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, well... we've got a whole lot of 
feelings we wanna talk about too, y'know. 
That's why we set up this table today, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Why hasn't Oguri, the star of the show, 
shown up yet!? It's food! And an 
all-you-can-eat course, no less!?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...! Don't tell me... she starved herself 
so much for today that she collapsed...?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: —Forgive me, I'm late!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, finally the star of the show 
arrives! My neck was stretched out waiting 
for you for so long it almost touched the 
ground!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...I ended up running late because I was 
preparing my speech.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
“Yes. Everyone went through the trouble of 
preparing this seat for me. I was told 
that on such occasions, one ought to give 
a proper greeting.”

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, I appreciate the thought, but... 
It's kind of unsettling when you do 
something so out of character.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Very well, let us begin. *Ahem*――

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
“—I am Oguri Cap. An Umamusume attending 
Tracen Academy.”

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Why are ya startin' with 
self-introductions when it's just family 
here...?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"When I first came to the academy, I ran 
without thinking much about it. Just 
because it made people happy. Because it 
was fun. That was all there was to it."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
“—Yet, even as I kept thinking that, my 
feelings gradually began to change.”

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"It all started when she and her Trainer 
decided on a goal together. And then—"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"—Because I've found so many rivals that I 
genuinely, truly don't want to lose to."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Even if I practice with all my might and 
run with all my might, there are rivals 
waiting in the race whom I still might not 
beat."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"What made me happy was that all those 
strong rivals were trying their absolute 
hardest just to beat me."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"‘When I thought that, even right now, 
everyone is getting faster, I just wanted 
to run so badly... I couldn't help it, I 
just had to run.’"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"—And before I knew it, my mind was 
completely filled with thoughts of racing 
alongside everyone."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Because I had all of you, these three 
years flew by in an instant... and were 
truly wonderful. That is how I feel."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you... everyone. And please 
continue to look after me in the days 
ahead."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
—How was it, I wonder... I gave it some 
serious thought in my own way, but...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Well, well, well! What do we have 
here?! That's quite a nice story you're 
tellin' us, Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You've grown so admirable before I even 
realized it, Oguri-chan... I'm just so 
happy...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Come on... I worried for nothing. ...That 
was actually a great speech."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
—Thank goodness. Looks like they liked it. 
Well then, next up is the speech to 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Of course. I've been thinking about this 
for a long time. Now then, ahem... "My 
Trainer, by Oguri Cap."
choice_data_list:
H-Hold on, this is kind of 
embarrassing...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: "To me, my Trainer is—"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah. Besides, ya know, I think stuff 
like that is better said veeeery slowly 
when it's just the two of you."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: What? Is that how it works?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, that's how it is. C'mon, let's eat 
first. We've got mountains of stuff we 
wanna talk about too."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I see... All right, understood. Well then, 
everyone... shall we begin?

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you for the meal!
